page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.t5-c1m4.large is a burstable virtual machine instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor operating at 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 2 vCPUs derived from 1 physical core with hyper-threading enabled, alongside 8.0 GB of system memory. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and features a baseline network bandwidth of 0 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations indicate that this instance is positioned in the lower tier of performance. The stress-ng single-core CPU test yielded a score of 1057.79, while the multi-core test reached 2090.03, placing it in the bottom 10% to 25% of tested systems. Memory bandwidth is also limited, with large block read-only speeds at 16.3 GB/sec and write speeds at 14.44 GB/sec. Geekbench scores reflect this entry-level profile, with a single-core score of 870.0 and a multi-core score of 1493.0.

Due to its burstable CPU allocation model and entry-level hardware specifications, this instance offers a highly cost-efficient profile for workloads with low baseline CPU utilization that require occasional bursts. It is suitable for lightweight applications such as static web serving, basic Redis caching, development environments, and small-scale testing. It is not recommended for sustained high-compute tasks, large-scale database operations, or memory-intensive workloads.
